verdict.rationale: Open-protocol access and standards-based export are fair questions for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Shortwave connects through Gmail's APIs rather than IMAP and works only with Gmail, and it documents no IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access or standards-based export of its own. Users' ability to fall back to Gmail is a host-platform property, not a Shortwave capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
